topic: How Fees and Expenses Affect Your Investment Portfolio
subtopic: How Fees and Expenses Affect Your Investment Portfolio
source_evidence: This is because fees and expenses reduce the amount of money in your investment portfolio earning a return.
answer: Fees and expenses reduce the amount of money in your portfolio that can earn returns. Even fees that seem small can have a large impact over time. The source illustrates this with a hypothetical $100,000 investment growing 4% annually for 20 years: it would be worth approximately $208,000 with a 0.25% annual fee, $198,000 with a 0.50% fee, and $179,000 with a 1.00% fee. Fees may be transaction-based, charged when you buy, sell, or exchange an investment, or ongoing, charged regularly even when there are no transactions. Understanding and comparing the fees you may pay can help you see how they affect your portfolio.
